languageModelTools.name: obsidian_brain
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Global knowledge store using Obsidian vault that persists across ALL workspaces. IMPORTANT: ALWAYS search brain BEFORE doing anything else - you may have solved this before. ASSUME INTERRUPTION: Your context might reset anytime - any learning NOT in brain is LOST FOREVER across ALL future sessions. MID-TASK RULE: Every 3-5 tool calls, record any decisions, solutions, or learnings to brain immediately. DO NOT batch for end. Operations: 'search' (ALWAYS first), 'list' (browse structure), 'read' (get content), 'write' (create note), 'append' (PREFERRED - add to existing), 'quick_note' (fast capture to _Inbox), 'str_replace' (edit existing), 'insert' (add at line), 'delete' (remove note), 'move' (reorganize). Vault structure: /Engineering/ (projects), /Playbooks/ (how-tos), /Decisions/ (ADRs), /Snippets/ (patterns), /_Inbox/ (quick notes). Use brain for LONG-TERM knowledge valuable across projects. Use memory tool for workspace-specific progress.

filepath.description: Path to the note file (required for read, write, append, str_replace, insert, delete, move)

content.description: Content to write, append, insert, or for quick_note

directory.description: Directory to list (optional for list operation, defaults to root)

old_str.description: Text to find and replace (required for str_replace)

insert_line.description: Line number for insertion (1-indexed, required for insert)

languageModelTools.name: memory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Manage persistent memory across conversations through workspace-scoped files stored in the Obsidian vault's _Workspaces/[workspace-name]/ directory. This tool allows you to create, read, update, and delete memory files that persist between sessions. IMPORTANT: ALWAYS view your memory directory (/memories) before doing anything else to check for earlier progress. As you make progress on tasks, record status, progress, and thoughts in your memory. ASSUME INTERRUPTION: Your context window might be reset at any moment - any progress not recorded is LOST. Keep memory organized, delete files no longer relevant, avoid creating unnecessary files. Use memory for WORKSPACE-SPECIFIC context. Use obsidian_brain for knowledge valuable across ALL projects. Operations: 'view' (read file or list directory), 'create' (new file), 'str_replace' (edit), 'insert' (add at line), 'delete' (remove), 'rename' (move/rename).

command.description: The memory operation to perform: view, create, str_replace, insert, delete, or rename

path.description: Path to the file or directory within /memories. Must start with /memories/ for security.

view_range.description: Optional [start_line, end_line] to read specific lines (1-indexed, for view command)

file_text.description: Complete content for the file (required for create command)

old_str.description: Exact text to find and replace (required for str_replace)

insert_line.description: Line number for insertion, 1-indexed (required for insert)

languageModelTools.name: integrated_filesystem
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Integrated filesystem operations without requiring external MCP server configuration. Provides all common file operations directly within VS Code. Operations: 'read_file' (read single file with optional head/tail), 'read_multiple_files' (parallel file reads), 'write_file' (create/overwrite), 'list_directory' (list contents), 'directory_tree' (recursive JSON tree), 'move_file' (move/rename), 'search_files' (glob pattern search), 'create_directory' (create dirs), 'get_file_info' (metadata). All paths are validated against allowed directories for security.

languageModelTools.name: chat_history
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search and browse VS Code chat history across ALL workspaces. Indexes all Copilot/agent chat sessions stored by VS Code. Operations: 'search' (full-text search with optional date/workspace filters), 'list_sessions' (browse sessions with previews), 'read_session' (read complete conversation), 'get_stats' (statistics about chat history), 'export_session' (export to Obsidian vault), 'rebuild_index' (force refresh). Supports date filters: 'today', 'yesterday', 'last_week', 'last_month', or ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Use this to recall past conversations, find solutions discussed before, or export valuable conversations to your Obsidian brain.
